desc.p: The owner archives the geocache. The listing and all its logs stay; the cache can no longer be found or logged as found.

It works like services/logs/submit with logtype "Archived": it publishes the same status log entry, with the same rules, on every installation. Only the owner of the geocache may change its status. Two differences: the geocache must be available or temporarily unavailable (a status the geocache already has is refused, so no status log entry is written for nothing), and the comment is always plain text.

opt.name: comment
opt.p: Text of the status log entry, plain text (no HTML), as the owner wrote it. OKAPI adds no text of its own; an empty comment gives a status log entry without text, as the website writes it.

opt.name: langpref
opt.p: Language of the message returned, as in services/logs/submit.

returns.p: The same dictionary as services/logs/submit returns (success, message, log_uuid, log_uuids). As there, a refused status change (including one to the status the geocache already has) is success false with a message for the user, not an HTTP error.
